report.answer_text: The Mississippi River ranges from 20–30 feet wide at its source at Lake Itasca, Minnesota, to more than 11 miles wide where it broadens into Lake Winnibigoshish. Its widest shipping channel is about 2 miles wide at Lake Pepin. (nps.gov)
